Fine-tuned on the paired labels the design fits its training pairs at 1.00 but reaches only 0.30 held out at 600 positions and 0.29 at 1,202: not a capacity limit, a generalisation one. Piles are summed per pile slot, not merged; a card's summary never sees the player's state.
